vision_extraction.description: When image input arrives and the downstream analyst is not vision_capable, route the image through a vision-LANGUAGE model that returns text. The 'slot' field names a slot in the 'slots' block whose preferred + fallback chain is reused; that slot must contain multimodal LLMs (text+image → text), NOT image-generation models. The dedicated 'image_extracts' slot is the canonical home: GPT-5 / Claude Opus 4.7 / Gemini 3 Pro / GPT-4o. When the slot's chain produces no vision-input-capable entry, route_for_image_input sets context_pkg['no_vision_available'] = True and the manual-trace UX (WP-4.4) takes over. The earlier preferred_extractor_bucket / fallback_extractor_bucket bucket-fallback path was retired in install Chunk 12 (2026-05-19).

web_supplement.description: DEPRECATED 2026-05-19. Superseded by web_consultation (below) per F-Consult. Disabled by default; section retained so the legacy test_web_supplement.py / test_web_supplement_integration.py suites continue to exercise the old gap-driven sequential flow until they are migrated to the new module. New code should use web_consultation.

web_consultation.description: Step 2 F-Consult web consultation stream. When enabled, the fast model in the step1_cleanup slot identifies search intents from the user prompt (each intent must articulate a one-line justification — anti-nitpicking enforced at the model layer, not via a count cap); all intent queries then fire in parallel via ThreadPoolExecutor with per_query_timeout_seconds bounding each one. Retrieved chunks are tier-classified (whitelisted/corroborated/single/excluded) via tools.web_corroboration.TrustedSourcesRegistry against Reference — Trusted Web Sources, then scored and provenanced for downstream weighting. prompt_sanity.enabled toggles a parallel light factual-sanity check that flags surface-level errors in the user prompt (typos on dates, mis-attributed quotes, named-entity slips); flags are advisory, never blocking. conflict_detection.enabled toggles a fast-model pass that compares each web chunk against the vault concept-RAG and adds [CONFLICT: ...] markers to web chunks whose specific factual claims contradict vault content; substantive disputed positions and contrarian content in the vault pass through untouched (the detector is instructed to flag only specific verifiable facts, NOT enforce mainstream consensus). The four consultation streams (vault concept, conversation, relationship, web) run in parallel — there is no token debt across pipeline steps because each step receives a fresh window. See Specification — F-Consult.md for the design.

_search_cascade_order_note: Provider cascade consulted by orchestrator/tools/web_search.py. tavily = Tavily API (TAVILY_API_KEY env; LLM-friendly result shape, smaller free tier). brave = Brave Search API (BRAVE_API_KEY env; survives MSI production burst that DDG silently rate-limits). exa = Exa neural/semantic search (EXA_API_KEY env; embedding-based retrieval that complements the keyword tiers — add 'exa' to this list to enable as a cascade tier, OR use the semantic_augment block below to merge Exa results alongside the keyword cascade rather than as a fallback). ddg = DuckDuckGo (no key required; always available as the keyless tail of the cascade). Providers without a configured key are skipped silently. Unknown provider names in this list are dropped with a stderr warning. Default order if this field is absent: tavily → brave → ddg. Keys are stored in the macOS keychain under service='ora', username='<provider>-api-key' and exported to env at orchestrator startup by boot.py::_export_search_keys_to_env.
_semantic_augment_note: When enabled and the named provider's key is present, web_search callers that opt in (semantic_augment=True) run the keyword cascade AND a provider-only semantic search in parallel and merge the two (dedup by URL) — so semantic results SUPPLEMENT keyword results rather than replacing them. Opted-in callers: Step-2 web consultation (web_consultation.py) and the model-facing web_search dispatcher tool. NOT opted in: claim_verification.py (fact-checking wants keyword precision, not semantic similarity) and the legacy web_supplement.py. Set enabled=false to turn the feature off without removing the key. No-op when the provider has no key, so clean / no-key installs and forks are unaffected. provider must be a registered provider in web_search.py::_PROVIDERS (currently only 'exa' is a semantic provider).

image_generates._note: General-purpose image generation slot. Serves news photos, illustration filler, and the eventual data-viz illustration fallback. Preferred = openai-gpt-image-1 (artistic richness, moderation-lottery on boundary-pushing prompts); Fallback 1 = Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (catches OpenAI safety_violations refusals); Fallback 2 = local-diffusers (SD 1.5 last-resort if both cloud providers fail). The registry's invoke() walks the chain on prompt_rejected / model_unavailable / quota_exceeded — see capability_registry.fallback_triggering_codes. Editorial cartoons go through a separate slot (`image_generates_cartoon`) so style-locked LoRA fallbacks are only invoked on the cartoon path. DALL-E references removed 2026-05-12 per OpenAI's same-day shutdown announcement.

image_generates_cartoon._note: MSI editorial-cartoon slot (Hector Rentier). Publisher chain revised 2026-05-27: GPT-5.4 Image 2 preferred (best fidelity when it accepts), but it moderation-refuses Hector's butt-face caricature anatomy. On a refusal the OpenRouter integration classifies the empty-image response as prompt_rejected and the registry walks the chain — FIRST to Nano Banana 2 (google/gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview) because Google does NOT refuse this content, so cloud-quality output is produced without falling to the LoRA; then Nano Banana Pro (gemini-3-pro-image-preview) and GPT-5 Image as further cloud options; then the style-locked civitai-hector-lora-v1 backstop only if every cloud provider fails. Putting a non-refusing Google model in the backup position is the publisher's fix for the GPT moderation lottery (keeps the established §5.4.1 look on a cloud renderer instead of the lower-quality LoRA). This explicit entry fully overrides the MSI manifest routing (merge_project_capability_slots skips the manifest routing when a publisher entry exists). local-diffusers omitted; gpt-5-image-mini omitted (full models only).

image_extracts._note: Per-pipeline vision-language extraction slot. Read by route_for_image_input when an analyst model is not vision_capable. Each pipeline (interactive / agent) picks one multimodal LLM (text+image -> text); the OTHER pipeline’s pick is used as the automatic backup when the primary is unavailable. Edit via Settings -> Buckets tab -> Image Extracts card (right column). DO NOT put image-GENERATION models here (gpt-image-2, etc.) — those are tuned for text+image -> image output and don’t reliably emit JSON descriptions, which causes the request to hang. All entries must be multimodal LLMs whose output is text and whose input includes image. Validate against catalog by_input_modality.image when adding entries.

_schema_notes.vision_capable_source_of_truth: config/models.json is canonical. routing-config.json::endpoints[].vision_capable is a duplicate kept for backward compatibility; Router.vision_capable_for_endpoint() reads models.json first. Field removal from endpoints[] is queued as a follow-on task to install Chunk 12 — blocked on expanding models.json to per-variant entries since most routing-config endpoint ids (e.g. anthropic-api-opus-3) are not present in models.json today.
_schema_notes.vision_extraction_bucket_fallback_retire: vision_extraction.preferred_extractor_bucket and .fallback_extractor_bucket were retired in install Chunk 12 (2026-05-19). route_for_image_input is slot-only — when the configured slot's chain produces no vision-input-capable entry, context_pkg['no_vision_available'] = True and WP-4.4 takes over.
_schema_notes.pipelines_block_retired: See _pipelines_retired marker. Removed in install Chunk 2d (2026-05-18). All slot resolution flows through config/configurations/<name>.json via Router auto-derivation from context.
_schema_notes.canonical_identifier_form: TARGET: <provider>:<model_id> for cloud, bare id for local. CURRENT: mixed (some endpoints already use the prefix form, others use bare slugs). Migration to canonical form scheduled for Chunk 12.
_schema_notes.v1_compat_fields_carried: slot_assignments, gear4_overrides, default_endpoint, operational_context were added 2026-05-19 (install Chunk 12 step 4) so that load_endpoints() and its 10+ downstream callers in boot.py, compaction.py, scheduler.py, model_dispatch.py, milestone_executor.py, framework_input_gap.py, batch_processor.py, subagent.py can read this file in place of the legacy endpoints.json. The fields are seeded verbatim from endpoints.json. Step 5 repoints load_endpoints() at routing-config.json; step 7 deletes endpoints.json.
